mcci-xp-level-color.title: MCCI XP Level Color Config
mcci-xp-level-color.category.general.too: Settings for the MCCI XP Level Color mod.
mcci-xp-level-color.mode.description:
Which colors to use for the XP level text.

Vanilla: Default vanilla colors.
Static: Changes the colors to fit the MCCI XP bar texture.
Dynamic: The colors will change based on your Crown Level.
Custom: Uses custom colors set in the options below.
mcci-xp-level-color.custom-color.descrip: The color of the XP level text when in Custom mode.
mcci-xp-level-color.custom-outline-color: The color of the XP level text outline when in Custom mode.
mcci-xp-level-color.disable-mcci-check.d: Will make the mod also work outside of MCC Island.
